author: feral-core
description: Create and inspect persistent background work using the in-process TaskFlow adapter. A durable accepted handoff means the job was stored, not that its actions were approved or completed. Each step retains the existing execution bounds and policy gates; uncertain effects require reconciliation.
trigger_phrases: work on this for a while
run this as a background task

endpoints.description: Create a persistent background goal or ordered subtasks. Returns a flow_id and creation handoff receipt. Say the task was accepted only when handoff.accepted is true. Do not claim completion, inherited action permission, an attached notification subscription, or unlimited work.

params.name: goal
params.description: Natural-language description of the single background job, e.g. 'research the top 5 competitors and summarize each'. Provide this OR subtasks.

params.name: subtasks
params.description: Ordered list of sub-goals to run one after another in the background. Use for multi-stage work so progress is checkpointed between stages.

params.name: title
params.description: Short human-readable title for the task list UI.

endpoints.returns_description: {ok, flow_id, steps, status, title, handoff: {accepted, durable, replayed, origin, replay_protected, action_outcome, result_subscription}}

endpoints.description: Check progress of a background task by flow_id. Use this when the user asks how a task is going.
endpoints.returns_description: {flow_id, title, status, current_step, steps_total, steps_completed, error}

endpoints.description: List recent background tasks and their statuses.
